description: Hand-labelled documents for organisation extraction (KG-13 slice 3b). Gold lists the organisations a document names as an organisation: companies, customers, vendors, partners, investors, regulators, government bodies, universities, non-profits. Not gold: people, products and services (Jira, Salesforce used as a CRM tool, iPhone), teams and departments, locations, generic words, the application the record came from, and the tenant itself (filtered after extraction). Each gold entry lists accepted spellings of one organisation. Written for this eval, not taken from customer data. Names that are fairly read either way (a company named as the tool it makes: "Datadog", "DocuSign", "GitHub") are listed under optional: predicting one is not a false positive, missing one is not a miss.
